claim_text: In NF1, 11.5% of pheochromocytomas are malignant, with about 84% solitary adrenal tumors and 9.6% bilateral adrenal tumors; mean age at presentation is about 42 years.
notes: Full text from locally supplied PDF (Nat Rev Dis Primers 2017; not in PMC). Statement made by the Gutmann 2017 Primer citing ref 160 Opocher 2005 PMID 15883705. Secondary citation: not independent of the cited primary work; primary paper should be read for strength grading.
